name: Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna Kit - Scandinavian Spruce | 2, 3 or 5 Person
description: Description Imagine stepping into a space where the noise of the day dissolves—the soft scent of Scandinavian spruce, the gentle glow rising behind an obeche backrest, and the deep, enveloping warmth that eases your body into stillness. The KOHLER® C1™ Indoor Sauna turns a simple corner of your home into your personal retreat, a place where restoration isn’t an occasional luxury…it’s a daily rhythm. Because this isn’t just a sauna; it’s the identity of someone who values the long game—someone who chooses a lifestyle of grounded energy, deeper sleep, and anchored well-being. The C1’s craftsmanship, from its hand-selected woods to its precision-engineered heat control, reflects a commitment to living with intention. Why do you think homeowners who prioritize longevity and mental clarity consistently call daily heat exposure a “non-negotiable”? It’s because the benefits compound—stress drops, recovery improves, and the mind resets. And with a true freestanding FERO heater at its center, the C1 delivers the authentic, mineral-rich heat that makes these results possible. And yes—you may be weighing the investment. But consider the trade-off: spa visits, memberships, self-care purchases that fade as quickly as they’re made. This isn’t one more expense. It’s a long-term asset built into the architecture of your home, delivering years of improved health, calm, and connection. Picture yourself a few weeks from now: stepping into warm light each evening, feeling your breathing deepen, your shoulders drop, your thoughts clear. Waking each morning more rested than the last. This becomes your new normal—because you’ve brought the ritual of renewal home. Features Premium Scandinavian Spruce Interior & Exterior — A naturally warm, inviting aesthetic that elevates your home while withstanding heat and moisture with ease. Freestanding FERO Electric Sauna Heater — Provides a traditional Finnish-style experience with smooth, consistent heat for deeply restorative sessions. 2700K Warm White Indirect Lighting — Positioned behind the backrest to create calming, spa-like ambiance. Dual Thermostatic Control — Ensures stable heat levels, predictable results, and safety during every session. External Digital Display — Effortlessly controls temperature, session time, and indirect lighting without disturbing the heat inside. Aerotherm Ventilation System — Maintains oxygen-rich airflow for comfort, clarity, and better endurance. 2.1” (5.4 cm) Mineral Wool Insulation — Enhances heat retention while improving efficiency and structural stability. Tempered Glass Door and Windows (0.3” / 0.8 cm) — Offers a sense of spaciousness while maintaining exceptional heat containment. Cool-Touch Beech Wood Handles — Comfortable grip even at peak temperature. Tongue-and-Groove Wall Construction — Creates a clean, seamless visual finish and enhances cabin longevity. Three Cabin Sizes Available — Configured for 2, 3, or 5 users to perfectly fit your space and lifestyle goals. What's Included?
